channel.title: Uzbekistan passport: visa rule changes
channel.description: Destinations whose entry rule changed for Uzbekistan passport holders, found by the daily comparison of public visa-policy sources (mainly Wikipedia). Check the official source before you travel.

item.title: Thailand: Visa-free → Visa required
item.description: Thailand: visa-free before, visa required now, for Uzbekistan passport holders. Seen in the daily data check on 28 September 2026.

item.title: South Africa: Visa required → eVisa
item.description: South Africa: visa required before, eVisa now, for Uzbekistan passport holders. Seen in the daily data check on 25 September 2026.

item.title: Hong Kong: Visa-free → Visa required
item.description: Hong Kong: visa-free before, visa required now, for Uzbekistan passport holders. Seen in the daily data check on 3 July 2026.

item.title: Macao: Visa required → Visa on arrival
